provenance.invariant: A one-day all-day event: DTSTART;VALUE=DATE on the day, DTEND;VALUE=DATE on the NEXT day (RFC 5545 exclusive end). The input deliberately mixes shapes — start as a bare date string, end as an instant — the exact mix that once produced a zero-duration event.
